title: Wine Tasting and Walking Tour of Carmel-by-the-Sea
includes: Tour guide gratuities are not included but always gratefully received
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
While some of Carmel’s wine tasting rooms welcome children, this tour isn’t recommended for children.
Minimum age is 21 years for alcohol consumption.
policies: We recommend wearing comfortable clothing and shoes for walking.
Please make sure you check the forecast and come prepared - our tours happen rain or shine.
While food isn’t included in the tour, our seasoned local guides can make countless restaurant recommendations after the tour concludes. We certainly recommend you have lunch before joining us.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: During your tour you'll enjoy visits to three hand-selected wine tasting rooms with carefully curated tastings at each one. You'll also learn from local sommeliers about the region’s unique climates that produce a variety of world-renowned wines. And when it comes to enjoying Carmel, while guide books and websites might steer you in the right direction, there’s nothing quite like experiencing Carmel through the eyes of a local. Our expert guides will bring the town’s storied history to life. Going beyond the standard highlights you will explore what lies off the beaten path. And if you’re looking to make the most of your visit after the tour, our walking concierges will share our best recommendations for restaurants, bars, shopping, hiking and more!
